title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Elementary and Secondary Education Foundation Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Elementary and Secondary Education Foundation Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXII OF 2017
ACT XXXII OF 2017
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ELEMENTARY AND
SECONDARY EDUCATION FOUNDATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Elementary and Secondary Education Foundation
Ordinance, 2002
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Elementary and
Secondary Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance
No. XXX of 2002), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Elementary and Secondary Education
Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
